title: The Anderson Conjecture: A Weakly Quasi-Complete Ring Need Not Be Quasi-Complete
abstract: Formalizes a counterexample to Anderson's question, constructing a weakly quasi-complete Noetherian local ring that is not quasi-complete via the Jensen-Heitmann-Loepp transfinite construction.

informal.anderson_main_theorem: Proves that there exists a weakly quasi-complete Noetherian local ring that is not quasi-complete.
